name: Witness list builder
description: Everyone the record mentions, what each person knows, and the documents that show it.

steps.title: People in each document
steps.instructions: List every person named, their role, and what the document shows they know or did, with the line pointer.

steps.title: Witness list
steps.instructions: Merge into one witness list: name, role, subjects of knowledge, and the documents that prove it. Flag anyone who appears in conflicting records.

rubric.text: Every subject of knowledge is tied to a document.
